text:
maya: Quick heads-up — onboarding sample deployed to a customer on Vercel Edge failed with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. Minimal repro and package.json snippet below. Anyone encountered this from the last packaging tweak? :frowning:

omri: yep, got a support ticket too. Paste the import + package.json?

maya: import in edge function:
```js
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference';
const c = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await c.generate('hello');
```
error: `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED: Package subpath './lib/index.js' is not defined by "exports"`
package.json excerpt shipped in SDK: 
```json
{"name":"redwood-inference","version":"6.0.0","main":"lib/index.cjs","exports":{"./lib/index.js":"./lib/index.cjs"},"types":"lib/index.d.ts"}
```

lee: root cause: exports only points at the CJS artifact under the lib subpath. Modern bundlers/edge runtimes try to resolve ESM paths (./lib/index.js or ./lib/index.mjs) and respect package exports strictly — they won't fall back to main. TS/IDE will also fail to pick up types reliably when an exports map exists but doesn't surface typings.

omri: quick local test: changing exports to include a root mapping with import/require/types fixes the error. Example that worked for me: 
```json
{"exports":{".":{"import":"./lib/index.mjs","require":"./lib/index.cjs","types":"./lib/index.d.ts"},"./package.json":"./package.json"},"types":"lib/index.d.ts"}
```

maya: nice. For the short term, what do we tell support/customers?

lee: two options to unblock: 1) pin to previous patch that didn't change exports, or 2) import explicit ESM path `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference/lib/index.mjs'` (if they can). Not ideal but workable until we publish a fix.

omri: longer-term: we should publish a patch that reverts the restrictive mapping and then a follow-up with proper dual exports + types. Also add a tiny ESM entry (lib/index.mjs) that re-exports public API if building full ESM is heavy.

maya: agree. Also recommend adding CI smoke checks that run our sample apps on a Vercel Edge emulator + Cloudflare Pages preview + simple TS server check for intellisense so we catch regressions.

docs: I'll draft a short KB about export map pitfalls with edge runtimes and TypeScript, include example package.json shapes and recommended workarounds.

ci-bot: opened PR revert/exports-restrictive -> #3420 and added packaging-smoke-matrix job to CI (vercel-emulator, cloudflare-preview, node18/20).

maya: action items summary:
- omri: cut revert patch release and include changelog (P0)
- lee: add ESM thin entry + dual-export mapping in follow-up (P0)
- infra: wire packaging-smoke-matrix to packaging PRs (P1)
- docs: KB + support note with short-term workaround (P2)

omri: i'll coordinate the release once CI green. Thanks for the quick triage everyone. :thumbsup:
